entries.name: Yamaki
entries.description: Marque japonaise de guitares acoustiques, d'abord classiques puis à cordes acier de style Martin, fondée par Kazuyuki Teradaira et vendue par la firme Daion.

sources.title: List of Japanese OEM guitar manufacturers
sources.excerpt: Founded by Kazuyuki Teradaira as a maker of classical guitars. Yamaki guitars were sold by Daion.

sources.title: Yamaki YW-50-12
sources.excerpt: In 1967 Kazuyuki left Zenon to produce classical guitars under the name Yamaki

entries.name: Saturn
entries.description: Marque de guitares électriques construites au Japon (par Kawai et/ou Guyatone, attribution discutée) et vendues au Canada par les magasins Eaton dès le catalogue de 1968. À ne pas confondre avec le modèle Saturn de Hopf.

sources.title: Saturn guitars
sources.excerpt: Saturn guitars – made in Japan by Kawai and Guyatone (bottom example). (different to Saturn model by Hopf). They appeared in the 1968 Canadian Eaton's catalog.

sources.title: No Will Power: Another Vintage Saturn Guitar
sources.excerpt: Some say they were built in Japan by Kawai, others say Guyatone, but everyone seems to agree that Saturns first appeared in a 1968 Eaton's department store catalogue.

entries.name: Alhambra
entries.description: Fabricant espagnol de guitares classiques (aussi flamenco et acoustiques) fondé en 1965 à Muro de Alcoy (Alicante), du modèle d'initiation au haut de gamme.

sources.title: Who are we?
sources.excerpt: In 1965, after years of growth and the entry of new partners who contributed their vision, 'Manufacturas Alhambra, SA' was born. All our guitars are made in Muro de Alcoy (Alicante).

sources.title: 9 Great 'Made in Spain' Classical Guitars Compared
sources.excerpt: Established in 1965 … in Alicante, Spain … the whole range from beginner instruments to pro quality guitars.
